parameters.content:
## Mossgrove 8: Reset Demo
Puts the Google Sheet back to the demo state: settings, a 26-item price book, nine sample quotes at every stage (draft, sent, accepted, booked, invoiced, paid, declined, expired) with dates relative to today, their history and payments, both crews' calendars, and an empty Outbox. Run it before a demo or recording.
